block.nuclearcraft.americium_rtg.desc: Radioisotope thermoelectric generator. Produces a steady 448 FE/t and emits radiation.
block.nuclearcraft.californium_rtg.desc: Radioisotope thermoelectric generator. Produces a steady 4096 FE/t and emits radiation.
block.nuclearcraft.decay_generator.desc: Generates energy from adjacent radioactive blocks. Emits radiation and decays those blocks to lead over time.
block.nuclearcraft.engineers_crafting_ta: AE2-terminal-style auto-crafter that stores container-block items and aggregates their inventories.
block.nuclearcraft.heat_exchanger_radiat: Vents %s H/t from the heat buffer. Passive: cools whenever the multiblock is formed.
block.nuclearcraft.pipe.desc: Passive network conduit. Connects only to other pipes and connectors.
block.nuclearcraft.pipe_connector.desc: Network I/O node. Interfaces the pipe network with adjacent machines. Right-click to configure; sneak-right-click to cycle mode.
block.nuclearcraft.plutonium_rtg.desc: Radioisotope thermoelectric generator. Produces a steady 1792 FE/t and emits radiation.
block.nuclearcraft.pu_239_bomb.desc: Warning: arms on redstone signal and detonates after a short fuse. Not safe for dispenser placement.
Generates 112 FE/t while exposed to daytime sky.

message.nc.multitool.armed_confirm: Armed. Press again within 60 ticks to detonate.
message.nc.multitool.not_your_project: Not your bomb — placement ownership required.
msr.input_rate.tooltip: Molten salt input rate (buckets/tick). Cold FLiBe drawn into the reactor each tick.
msr.output_rate.tooltip: Hot molten salt output rate (buckets/tick). Pumped out each tick — the reactor's only cooling. Run it too low and the core overheats.
screen.nuclearcraft.crafter.denied.too_c: Bill of materials exceeds planner limits.
screen.nuclearcraft.crafter.encode: Encode recipe onto a blank pattern
tooltip.nc.charging_station: Charges energy items from stored power and fills fluid items with Quantite Energy gas.
tooltip.nc.msr_controller.descr: Runs the Molten Salt Reactor: pumps FLiBe carrier salt past TRISO fuel pebbles, holds the chain reaction, and ships the heat out as hot salt. (No heat sinks, no moderators - just don't let the cooling stop.)
tooltip.nc.msr_port.descr: Loads fuel pebbles and pipes molten salt in and out. Cold salt in, hot salt out - and that hot-salt flow is the core's only cooling.
tooltip.nc.multitool.desc: Remote detonator: link a bomb or TNT, then use to fire
tooltip.nc.multitool.shift.desc: Sneak to bypass block interactions while linking
tooltip.nc.q36_hint: Right-click to switch mode. Left-click to fire.
tooltip.nc.use_in_leacher: Use in Leacher at this position
tooltip.nuclearcraft.decay_generator_all: Can be used with Decay Generator
tooltip.nuclearcraft.heat_sink.active: Needs coolant fluid supply into reactor to work.
tooltip.nuclearcraft.hev.desc: Grants extra protection and passive effects while charged
tooltip.nuclearcraft.moderator:
Fission Reactor moderator. Must be placed adjacent to a fuel cell. 
 Each face adjacent to a fuel cell adds +%s%% efficiency and +%s%% heat gen.
tooltip.nuclearcraft.use_wrench: Use a wrench to configure sides
